summary: Privacy-first AI meeting assistant that records, transcribes and summarises meetings on your own computer.

heroCommands.command: Get the Windows .exe or macOS .dmg from GitHub Releases

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: Meetily is an AI meeting assistant that captures meetings, transcribes them in real time and generates summaries, all on your own machine with a local model by default.
sixtySeconds.problem: Cloud meeting note-takers upload your conversations. Meetily keeps recordings and transcripts local.
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for a free, MIT-licensed app with live transcription and a choice of AI providers, from local Ollama to Claude, Groq, OpenRouter or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
requirements: Windows x64 or macOS Apple Silicon, or x86_64 Linux with glibc 2.35+

overview: Native apps exist for Windows (.exe) and macOS Apple Silicon (.dmg). On Linux, a one-line script installs the .deb or an AppImage, and manual packages are also available.

Meetily transcribes live during the meeting and summarises it afterwards with a local model by default. You can switch the AI provider to Ollama, Claude, Groq, OpenRouter or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
Get consent from participants before recording. Meetily is MIT licensed.
limitations: macOS build is Apple Silicon only
